result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue: the promotional banner text has severely insufficient color contrast against its light background.

issues.description: The promotional banner heading ('3 free deliveries for you') and subtitle ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') use white text on a very light mint-green background, making the text barely legible and failing WCAG color contrast requirements.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker background color (such as the app's primary dark green) for the promotional banner, or change the text color to dark green/charcoal to ensure sufficient contrast.
